source_policy: Derived statistics only; original Softimage assets and public exporter source are not committed.

confirmed_repeat_layout.source_evidence: The public dotXSI exporter writes SI_Texture2D UVSwap, URepeat, VRepeat, UAlternate, VAlternate, then UScale/VScale/UOffset/VOffset. In BZ2 TXMP the two small-integer words at +2/+4 sit immediately before the independently confirmed +6 scale/offset quartet and correlate with authored tiling patterns.

model_local_code400.implementation_consequence: Most model-local projected assets require repeat factors for correct texture density. The generated Blender UV path now applies them before +6 scale/offset and crop.

material_level_code401.implementation_consequence: Portable KHR_texture_transform and supported Blender material projections now include repeat factors rather than treating all code-401 textures as one tile per normalized UV interval.

remaining_neighbor_fields.post_path_plus0: raw u16, zero in all 664 validated records; consistent with the neighboring UVSwap source field but not promoted because the corpus contains no non-default anchor
